title: Chilean Coup d'État
description:
On September 11, 1973, the Chilean military, led by General **Augusto Pinochet**, overthrew the democratically elected government of Salvador Allende.

President Allende died during the assault on the presidential palace. Pinochet established a military dictatorship that lasted until 1990.

The regime was responsible for numerous human rights violations, including the torture and murder of thousands of political dissidents.
